title: Community answers
empty: No one has shared an answer yet. Be the first: make yours public from your result page.
lockedBody: Community answers unlock after you submit your own answer, so you can try it before seeing how others did it.
cantVoteOwn: You can't vote on your own answer
feedbackSummary: Feedback the author chose to share
privateQuestion: This question is private (from your own prompt or image), so answers to it can't be shared.
publishIntro: Other students will see the final text only, with your nickname. Photos are never shared. You can make it private again at any time.
nicknameHelp: Shown instead of your name. 2–20 letters, numbers, _ or -.
nicknameShort: Choose a nickname of at least 2 characters.
includeScore: Show my AI score or estimate
includeFeedback: Show a summary of my feedback
warnBody: Don't include phone numbers, emails, ID numbers or your school's name. We check automatically and will stop you if we find any.
